span.p: 3 · How the apps talk to Microsoft 365

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Tablet app (Expo / React Native)
kitchen kiosk · staff PIN
offline cache + upload queue

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Phone app (same Expo code)
alerts · sign-offs · close the day
EOD report · camera / QR

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Web console (Next.js)
builder · spreadsheet view
finance & admin
hosted on Netlify or Azure

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Entra ID via MSAL
managers / finance: own Microsoft login
kitchen tablet: one device account per site
+ staff PIN inside the app

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Microsoft Graph API
read & write SharePoint list items
upload photos / files
(standard — no premium licence)

div.style: color: rgb(59, 47, 107) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Secured flow calls (optional, premium)
HTTP-trigger flows with Entra auth
for 'submit EOD' style actions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
On list change
recalculate & validate EOD
failed check → corrective action
→ work order → contractor email

Scheduled
create today's checklists

targets lookup · reminders

Lists
